entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Centuries-old wizard of the Institute of Arcane Study in Tamingazin and expert on its artifacts, manipulated into betraying the Valley.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: Institution in Tamingazin where Aligarius studied artifacts.

entities.name: Tamingazin
entities.description: Valley on Dominaria invaded by Suderbod.

entities.name: Suderbod
entities.description: Nation whose army invaded the Valley.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Leader of a party that took control of Berimish in a bloodless coup, later assassinated.

entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Suderbod Ambassador who manipulated Aligarius with laced food.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: Powerful artifact stolen by Aligarius, tied to the Magewall.

entities.name: Berimish
entities.description: Place taken in a bloodless coup.

entities.name: Betrayal of Tamingazin
entities.description: Series of treacherous events that shook the Valley.

events.summary: Seeking excitement, Aligarius helps Tagard's bloodless coup to take Berimish.
events.quote: Aligarius, seeking excitement, helped Tagard in his bloodless coup to take control of Berimish

events.summary: Ursal manipulates Aligarius with food laced with addictive spices, beginning the Betrayal of Tamingazin.
events.quote: manipulated him with food laced with addictive, mind-altering spices

events.summary: Brainwashed, Aligarius assists in the assassination of King Tagard and steals artifacts including the Magewall Hub.
events.quote: Aligarius assisted in the assassination of King Tagard and stole several powerful artifacts

events.summary: Aligarius travels to Suderbod with Ursal and helps lift the Magewall, enabling the Suder invasion.
events.quote: By aiding in the lifting of the Magewall, he enabled the Suder army's invasion of the Valley of Tamingazin.

events.summary: After Solin's death, Aligarius snaps out of his stupor and escapes with the Magewall Hub; Ursal is killed by Recin.
events.quote: Aligarius managed to snap out of his stupor and escape with the Magewall Hub.

events.summary: Free of brainwashing, Aligarius returns to the Institute, humbled.
events.quote: Aligarius returned to the Institute of Arcane Study, profoundly humbled by his role in nearly destroying the Valley.

relations.quote: Aligarius Timni was a member of the Institute of Arcane Study on Dominaria in Tamingazin
Aligarius fell under the influence of Suderbod Ambassador Ursal Daleel
Ursal attacked, but was killed by Recin and eaten by an attalo
After Hemarch Solin 's death at the hands of Kitrin
